name: type-stack
title: Type Stack
description: A vertical stack of phrases that cycles with a directional slide, reserving the height of the longest phrase so surrounding layout never reflows; pauses on hover and focus.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Serif Display
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Timer Cycle: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
